title: Household Restock Shopping-Day Optimiser
dataSources: Consumable levels (`supply:level`), parcels (`delivery:parcel`), bin collections (`bincollection:event`), gift-card balances (`giftcard:balance`).
app: Household logistics feeds — smart-scale consumable trackers, parcel/delivery tracking APIs, council bin-collection calendars, and gift-card balance logs — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=supply:level
| stats latest(level_pct) as level, avg(daily_use_pct) as usage by item
| eval days_left=round(level/usage,1)
| eval week=floor(days_left/7)
| stats count as items by week
| sort week
description: Groups upcoming restocks by the week they are needed, helping you batch shopping trips efficiently.
value: Clustering reorders into fewer, fuller shops saves time, delivery fees, and the constant top-up runs.
implementation: Ingest consumable runways into `index=personal`; group items by the week they will run out.
visualization: Histogram of items needing restock by week.
grandmaExplanation: It groups what you will run out of by week, so you can do fewer, fuller shopping trips.
